title: like a rag doll (Remix)
style: Jazz-pop with a swing feel. Clean electric guitar plays syncopated jazz chords and melodic fills. Upright bass follows a walking pattern. Drums feature a swung ride cymbal pattern with light snare ghost notes and occasional rimshots. A baritone male vocal delivers a rhythmic, slightly staccato performance. A brass section consisting of trumpet and saxophone provides punchy stabs and a melodic solo. The track is in 4/4 time at 120 BPM in the key of G major.
lyrics:
[Intro]
[clean electric guitar playing syncopated jazz chords]
[upright bass walking line enters]
[swung drums with ride cymbal and light snare]
(Mmm-hmm-hmm-doo-doo-doo-doo)

[Verse 1]
[baritone male vocals]
Didn't play well
I'm under your spell
Hitting me around the court
Like a ragdoll
Like a ball on a string
Give it another fling
Hitting me around the court
Like a ragdoll

[Chorus]
Watch me fight
With all my might
Hitting me around the court
Like a ragdoll

[Verse 2]
You are the dog and I am the hog
Tap it, poke it, drive it, stoke it
Hitting me around the court like a ragdoll
(Doo-doo-doo-doo-doo-dat-you)

[Bridge]
[brass section enters with punchy stabs]
[trumpet and saxophone melodic solo]
[guitar continues rhythmic comping]

[Outro]
[brass section hits]
[drums and bass stop abruptly]
